scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:sync:dev: npm run mobile:which-env:dev && npm run build:mobile:dev && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=dev
scripts.mobile:sync:stage: npm run mobile:which-env:stage && npm run build:mobile:stage && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=stage
scripts.mobile:sync:prod: npm run mobile:which-env:prod && npm run build:mobile:prod && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=prod
scripts.mobile:android:dev: npm run mobile:which-env:dev && npm run build:mobile:dev && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=dev --platform=android
scripts.mobile:android:stage: npm run mobile:which-env:stage && npm run build:mobile:stage && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=stage --platform=android
scripts.mobile:android:prod: npm run mobile:which-env:prod && npm run build:mobile:prod && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=prod --platform=android
scripts.mobile:ios:dev: npm run mobile:which-env:dev && npm run build:mobile:dev && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=dev --platform=ios
scripts.mobile:ios:stage: npm run mobile:which-env:stage && npm run build:mobile:stage && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=stage --platform=ios
scripts.mobile:ios:prod: npm run mobile:which-env:prod && npm run build:mobile:prod && node scripts/capacitor-sync.mjs --profile=prod --platform=ios
